verified: Real Leumi-origin runtime is running with successful complete cycles, zero recorder failures and no latest recorder error.
Recent complete cycles each collected the full dynamic 561-security universe with requested=received=unique=561, missing=0 and duplicates=0.
GetSecuritiesData completed as three 187-security chunks with HTTP 200 and complete 187/187 responses.
Adjacent live cycles show changing market-data and provider-time fingerprints/change counts, proving the collected snapshot is not frozen.
IndexedDB contains universe=561, latest=561 and populated history; the Viewer is open against the persisted data.
Evidence across recorder sessions shows persisted history survives a new session boundary.
Repeated live Bookmarklet launch kept the recorder running and opened another Viewer; multiple Viewer windows are now an accepted contract because IndexedDB remains authoritative.
inferred: A fresh successful recorder session necessarily completed the configured universe-loading path, but the Debug Bundle does not directly record the MapHeat2 HTTP status.
